subject: EastUS3 maintenance advisory — staged restarts, KV-cache preservation & customer runbook
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Perry <sam.perry@acme-ml.com>, acct_ops@acme-ml.com
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-07-07T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: EastUS3 maintenance advisory — staged restarts, KV-cache preservation & customer runbook

Hi Sam / Acme team,

We're planning a scheduled maintenance window in the EastUS3 region next week to apply a kernel/driver refresh that addresses a rare networking stall we've seen under certain long-lived connections. Objective: reduce the probability of degraded tail latency for streaming workloads.

Window (planned):
- Start: 2027-07-10 00:00 UTC
- End: 2027-07-10 06:00 UTC
- Impact: rolling restarts of serving nodes in small batches (5-10% at a time). No broad tenant evictions anticipated; we will preserve KV cache where possible.

What this means for Acme ML:
- Short-lived requests should see no measurable disruption.
- For long streaming sessions (>30m), there's a small chance of an in-flight restart; clients should handle transient connection resets and re-establish streams.
- We will route traffic away from nodes undergoing restarts and automatically failover to warm pools.

Attached is a concise customer runbook with recommended client-side mitigations, an inner-loop checklist for reconnect logic, and a KV-cache verification script we will run pre/post window. Key items:
- Implement exponential backoff + jitter for reconnects (sample code in runbook).
- Persist cursors on your side if you need strict exactly-once semantics.

Internal ops notes (cc'd): Neha, Marcus — please confirm the final batch size and whether we can compress the window by 30 minutes if the early batches are clean. Grace — I'll need your CS team to send a short advisory to Acme's SRE contacts tomorrow morning with the runbook link.

Attachments: eastus3-maintenance-runbook.pdf, kv-cache-checklist.csv

Thanks,
Jonas
--
Jonas Weber
Head of Production Reliability
Redwood Inference

Jonas — thanks for the heads-up. I'll send the advisory to Sam and their SRE alias first thing tomorrow at 08:00 UTC.

A couple of quick asks before we send:
- Can Ops confirm the exact duration per batch (target 12 minutes per batch is our current default)?
- Any recommended message we should surface to users (e.g., "short streaming interruptions possible")?

I'll draft the email and include the runbook link; will paste it here for review.

Grace

1) Will encrypted in-memory KV caches be preserved through the restart, or do we need to warm them again?
2) Do you have a hard SLA on per-batch restart duration? We have some production pipelines that open long-lived streams; if we can schedule their traffic away for a guaranteed 20-minute window before we start, that'd be ideal.

Also, the runbook PDF is helpful — can you provide the small sample reconnect snippet as a plain-text gist or in the body of the advisory so our engineers can patch clients quickly?
